retrieval_policy.this_job: No external retrieval is required or performed. The kickoff is self-contained and does not depend on linked or restricted material.
retrieval_policy.public_links: A later authorized retrieval job may check public links. It must record the final URL, retrieval result, timestamp, checksum, license or access terms, and validator label before promoting content to available course material.
retrieval_policy.restricted_material: Do not bypass access controls, contact staff under false pretenses, use hidden or sealed references, or copy another student's files. Restricted material remains blocked unless legitimate authorization and provenance are recorded.
retrieval_policy.failure_handling: A failed or denied retrieval remains durable evidence and must not be relabeled as available. Link presence alone is not content availability.
retrieval_policy.unit_expansion: Only verified content or an explicitly manager-authored self-contained specification may support a later prepared unit; normalized resource records alone are insufficient.
